teamPage.title: Admin Dashboard - Team
teamPage.subtitle: Invite people into your organization and choose the role each of them receives.
teamPage.inviteHelp: Generate an invite link, pick the role the invitee is granted, and share the link. Signing in with it makes them a member of your organization.
teamPage.roleDesc: The role the invitee receives on joining. Shape what each role can do in Security → Roles.
teamPage.lastAdminHint: This is the only org admin. Promote someone else first.
teamPage.selfRemoveHint: Leave the organization from your profile instead.
teamPage.dangerHelp: Deleting removes every source, domain, table, role and invite in this organization, for everyone in it. Download the configuration first if you want to keep it.
teamPage.deleteWarning: This permanently destroys {{org}} and everything registered in it. It cannot be undone, and Provisa keeps no copy.
teamPage.emailDesc: Send the invitation to this address. Leave empty for a link you share yourself.
teamPage.inviteNotSent: The invitation for {{email}} was created but could not be sent ({{reason}}). Share this link instead: {{url}}
teamPage.inviteNoMail: This deployment does not send email, so nothing was sent to {{email}}. Share this link instead: {{url}}
